summary: MIT lecture by Patrick Winston on how to speak, using chalkboard outlines, props such as a bicycle wheel, and example slides to teach how to start, use time and place, boards, props and slides, persuade, get recognised and end a talk.

questions.question: On the 'Important rules' slide (Do not read, Be in the image, Keep images simple, Eliminate clutter), what name labels the diagram of two posts topped by a lintel?
In the US map-colouring program shown on screen, what 'Color count' is displayed in the status text above the map?
When the speaker says collaborators belong on the first slide and says 'These are the collaborators', which person is listed first on the slide?
questions.answer: Demosthenes (followed by Patrick Henry, Winston Churchill, the MIT Faculty)

questions.question: According to the speaker's bar story from the Navy Science Board, how many books had Dolores Eder written?
